* 3e5ae31 Add in-memory MemFileStore backend
* 38f66d6 Add tests for connection login sequence and client networking
* c82ba66 Add tests for file-transfer upload/download folder handlers
* 0802a90 Close resource and info fork writers after upload
* a42a596 Decouple FileStore from *os.File for object-store backends
* db8cc16 Encode Hotline time seconds from the 1904 Mac epoch
* 490422f Fix ST1023 lint: omit inferred io.Writer type in fork writer decls

* cd67c32 Ignore .worktrees directory
* 4df6b97 Ignore .worktress directory

releases.title: v0.20.0
releases.notes:
## New Feature

Mobius now supports TLS (Transport Layer Security) for encrypted connections between clients and the server. When enabled, TLS runs on separate ports alongside the standard unencrypted ports, allowing both secure and legacy client connections simultaneously.

For setup details, refer to: [tls.md](https://github.com/jhalter/mobius/blob/master/docs/tls.md)

## Changelog
* 357baa9 Add optional TLS support for encrypted client connections
